card.name: The word Placebo in trial tables
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word placebo ("Place" before "bo") in clinical trial tables and drug-versus-placebo comparisons. It also fires on words like "taking" or "receiving" right before "placebo".

modes.label: Place in Placebo
modes.description: The start of "Placebo" in a table header or comparison column, often right after a drug name or "Incidence in".
modes.example: Table 5. Change in Body Weight (kg) in 3-Week Bipolar Mania Trials (Adult Patients) VRAYLAR *<< Place>>bo (N=439)

modes.label: Verb before placebo
modes.description: A word like taking or receiving just before the word placebo in a comparison of groups.
modes.example: of a Long-Term Study in Subjects with Schizoaffective Disorder Open-Label Period Double-Blind Period INVEGA SUSTENNA<< Place>>bo INVEGA SUSTENNA

card.writes: It pushes the model to output "place" forms, which completes the word placebo.
card.plain: It spots the spot where the word placebo is about to appear in a trial comparison.
